scope: Read-only audit of existing public platform contracts for authoritative WorkingDraft saves
requirement: Compare expectedDraftVersion, enforce trusted current author and project scope, and atomically retain the original request key, digest and result with the accepted draft
supported: The original DataView can retain local draft editing and public validation
An already registered formal model command can be dispatched once through the current SDK
Native command adapters can retain fixed input and an unknown outcome in the original running instance
The shared save path can verify original generic CRUD changes without replaying an unknown write
unprovenServiceContracts: An existing deployed draft-save command with expected-version comparison and conflict zero-write guarantee
Server-fixed author and project authorization that cannot be overridden by caller input
Original request key uniqueness and digest matching in the same authoritative commit as the draft
Durable original-result lookup independent of the current draft version
A terminal not-committed result that excludes later execution

currentPathLimitations.finding: CRUD wire groups contain TableName and Added/Changed/Deleted; no independent expected-version condition
SPARK save transaction mode is explicitly unsupported; enabling a flag cannot create transaction semantics
The formal model command path forces sourceInputMode direct; single dispatch does not create durable idempotency
Direct mode does not execute stored ValueFun mappings; client-selected SystemData is not a trusted author contract
Original-instance capture is not a durable server request journal

responsibilities.authoritativeService: Version comparison, trusted author/scope, request uniqueness, digest matching, draft plus original-result commit and terminal outcomes
responsibilities.publicSdkAdapter: Only after the deployed service contract is verified, bind it into the original DataView/DataSet save and original-attempt recovery chain
responsibilities.smartBidBusiness: Canonical draft and target validation, conflict presentation and preservation of later edits; no separate owner or submitter

nextReadOnlyEvidence: Read only the exact authorized space model directory and registered candidate identity/input/output descriptions through the original DataSet; do not execute candidates
Obtain the deployed command identity/version and fixed server-side author, atomicity, expected-version and request-result contracts
Confirm an independent original-request lookup contract; an empty query or the current row is not terminal proof
Use current formal ClassModel guides for the minimal adapter only after the service contract is established
forbiddenSubstitutes: Client pre-read followed by ordinary CRUD
Browser Map or latest-request fields replacing a durable original result
Client userId or selectable SystemData as an unforgeable author
SQL, forged primary keys, expanded output/permissions or speculative unique constraints to manufacture atomicity
Replaying old root or FactVersion attempts whose original unknown capture was lost
javaSourceEvidence: Only existing research excerpts were available; no current Java checkout or deployed-service behavior was inferred from them
conclusion: Authoritative remote draft save is not proven by current contracts. This is not an exhaustive claim that the deployed service has no other registered capability.
